findings.name: Gatcha (Square One Mall)

findings.note: Titles are bare maimai (Japan), not maimai DX. Research allowlist only has maimai_dx; mapped both cabs there with likely (not certain classic-vs-DX). other = 舞战纪 Dance Battle. Gatcha still open (clawcade + playpark, Square One Mall Saugus).
